getstyle(s) =>
    switch s
        "solid" => line.style_solid
        "dashed" => line.style_dashed
        "dotted" => line.style_dotted

getsize(s) =>
    switch(s) 
        "auto" => size.auto
        "tiny" => size.tiny
        "small" => size.small
        "normal" => size.normal
        "large" => size.large
        "huge" => size.huge


gethalign(s) =>
    switch s
        "left" => text.align_left
        "right" => text.align_right
        => text.align_center

getvalign(s) =>
    switch s
        "top" => text.align_top
        "bottom" => text.align_bottom
        => text.align_center

G_BRK = "Breakers"
brkOn = input.bool(true, "Breakers", group = G_BRK,
    tooltip = "Bullish breaker: a low, a high and a lower low (the second low raids the first); after a close above "
    + "that high, price pulls back to the zone (long). Bearish breaker: a high, a low and a higher high; after a "
    + "close below that low, price pulls "
    + "back to it (short). Before the pullback, price has to make a swing high above the zone (bullish) / a "
    + "swing low below it (bearish), with the swing length below. When, on the pullback, a live bullish FVG or confirmed IFVG+ (long) or bearish FVG "
    + "or IFVG- (short) overlaps the zone, the breaker is drawn as a dashed rectangle with its mid line, from "
    + "its candle(s) to that pullback. The label of an overlapping IFVG+ / IFVG- turns bold and an "
    + "overlapping unlabeled, unmitigated bullish / bearish FVG gets B↑ / B↓. Each later pullback extends the "
    + "rectangle; it fails when a candle closes below the breaker low (bullish) / above its high (bearish), and "
    + "is erased then if no pullback had worked yet.")
brkMode = input.string("Last candle", "Zone", options = ["Last candle", "Whole sequence"], group = G_BRK,
    inline = "bm", tooltip = "Last candle: the last up-close candle making the high (bullish) / down-close "
