// Poor liquidity ============================================
G_PL = "Poor liquidity"
plMode = input.string("auto", "Poor liquidity", options = ["auto", "yes", "no"], group = G_PL,
    tooltip = "For thin markets, where price often jumps between two candles. On: volume imbalances are "+
        "ignored (FVG boxes are not extended over body gaps), and two up-close (down-close) candles in a row "+
        "with a gap between them make a bullish (bearish) FVG, as if an up (down) candle was in the middle. "+
        "auto: on for nano futures only (symbol or description with Nano / NNQ).")
bool poorLiq = plMode == "yes" or (plMode == "auto" and (str.contains(str.lower(syminfo.description), "nano")
     or str.startswith(syminfo.root, "NNQ") or str.startswith(syminfo.ticker, "NNQ")))

bounces(p) =>
    (math.abs(p-low) < 2 and close > low+10) or (math.abs(p-high)<2 and close < high-10)

var debug=false
var tfsecs = timeframe.in_seconds()
// Wicks ===================================================
wdx() =>
    r = wickdx
    if r == 0 and tfsecs/60 < 15
        r := 4
    else if r == 0
        r := 1
    r
var wicks = array.new<line>()
if dowick
    bodyh = math.max(open[1],close[1])
    bodyl = math.min(open[1],close[1])
    wh = high[1]-bodyh
    wl = bodyl-low[1]
    
    if wh > minwick
        ce = math.avg(high[1],bodyh)
        ln = line.new(bar_index-1, ce, bar_index-1+wdx(), ce, style = wicksty, color = hideReg ? color.new(wickcol, 100) : wickcol)
        wicks.push(ln)
    if wl > minwick
        ce = math.avg(low[1],bodyl)
        ln = line.new(bar_index-1, ce, bar_index-1+wdx(), ce, style = wicksty, color = hideReg ? color.new(wickcol, 100) : wickcol)
        wicks.push(ln)
    if wicks.size() > nwicks
        w = wicks.shift()
        w.delete()
    if dowickalert and barstate.isconfirmed
        for w in wicks
            p = w.get_y1()
            if bounces(p)
                if debug
                    line.new(bar_index,low,bar_index,high,extend = extend.both)
                alert("bounce on wick C.E.", alert.freq_once_per_bar)

// FVGs ======================================================

if tz == "Auto"
    if str.contains(syminfo.description, "DAX") or str.contains(syminfo.ticker, "DAX") or str.contains(syminfo.description, "Germany") or str.contains(syminfo.ticker, "FDX")
        fpfvgtime := "0900"
        tz := "Europe/Madrid"
    else
        tz := "America/New_York"

hmParse(string s) =>
    hs = str.substring(s, 0, 2)
    ms = str.substring(s, 2, 4)
    [int(str.tonumber(hs)), int(str.tonumber(ms))]

var fph = 0
var fpm = 0

if dofp
    [xh, xm] = hmParse(fpfvgtime)
    fph := xh
    fpm := xm

// FVG data type, one per handled fvg.
type FVG
    float hi // max value
    float lo // min value
    float ce // C.E.
    bool islong // bullish?
    int start  // time for start
    int end = na// time when mitigated
    int updEnd = na // [PERF] end already applied to the drawings (finished FVGs are then skipped)
    int inhSeq = na // [PERF] tagSeq when ifvgInherit last scanned for this IFVG
    box rect = na // box drawn
    line celine = na // CE line
    bool isfp = false // is first presented FVG
    bool iswfp = false // is week first presented FVG
    bool isffp = false // is Friday first presented FVG
    bool isifp = false // is first presented FVG inverse
    int sbar = na // [OTE] bar index where the FVG starts
    line hiln = na // segments style: high line
    line loln = na // segments style: low line
    bool kept = false // kept confirmed IFVG (box shown as IFVG)
    int kdir = 0 // -1 bearish IFVG, 1 bullish IFVG
    FVG dup = na // older almost identical FVG that absorbed this one
    bool cand = false // current IFVG candidate (its box is shown as IFVG)
    bool own = false // the box exists only because of the IFVG (the FVG itself is not drawn)
    bool shown = false // FVG is in the drawn arrays
    bool aplus = false // [DE] A+ FVG (born from an A+ MSS)
    bool disp = false // [DE] middle candle is a displacement candle
    bool brk = false // [BRK] tagged at a breaker pullback
    int brkD = 0 // [BRK] direction of that breaker
    int mbD = 0 // [MB] direction of the mitigation block it was tagged at (1 bullish, -1 bearish), 0 none
    int lblD = 0 // direction of the B / M / BM label
    bool ote = false // [OTEF] OTE FVG
    float oLo = na // [OTEF] leg low / high: origin and extreme since the FVG
    float oHi = na
    bool swp = false // [REL] last FVG before a sweep: shown once it becomes an IFVG
    bool ext = false // [REL] extended by a merged duplicate
    int dbar = na // [REL] bar index where it was filled

// [PERF] bumped whenever an FVG gets a breaker / mitigation block tag, is widened by a merge or a tagged one is
// drawn: ifvgInherit
// only rescans the FVGs when this changed (an array, since functions cannot assign global variables)
var array<int> tagSeq = array.from(0)
bumpTags() =>
    tagSeq.set(0, tagSeq.get(0) + 1)



// label of a plain FVG box: A+, or the breaker / mitigation block tag (B↑, M↓, BM↑...), plus OTE
fvgLbl(FVG f) =>
    string t = ""
    if f.aplus and lblAp
        t := hideReg ? "" : "A+"
    else if f.brk or f.mbD != 0
        t := (f.brk and f.mbD != 0 ? "BM" : f.brk ? "B" : "M") + (f.lblD == 1 ? "↑" : "↓")
    if f.ote and not hideReg
        t += (t == "" ? "" : " ") + "OTE"
    t

// [OTEF] swings of the chart timeframe for the leg origin
var float otePL = na
var int otePLb = na
var float otePH = na
var int otePHb = na
float otePivL = ta.pivotlow(low, pivL, pivR)
float otePivH = ta.pivothigh(high, pivL, pivR)
if not na(otePivL)
    otePL := otePivL
    otePLb := bar_index - pivR
if not na(otePivH)
    otePH := otePivH
    otePHb := bar_index - pivR



method kill(FVG f) =>
    if not na(f)
        if not na(f.rect)
            f.rect.delete()
        if not na(f.celine)
            f.celine.delete()
        if not na(f.hiln)
            f.hiln.delete()
        if not na(f.loln)
            f.loln.delete()
        f.rect := na
        f.celine := na
        f.hiln := na
        f.loln := na
method alerts(FVG f) =>
    a = false
    if not na(f.hi) and bounces(f.hi)
        alert("bounce on FVG hi", alert.freq_once_per_bar)
        a := true
    else if not na(f.lo) and bounces(f.lo)
        alert("bounce on fvg lo", alert.freq_once_per_bar)
        a := true
    else if not na(f.ce) and bounces(f.ce)
        alert("bounce on CE", alert.freq_once_per_bar)
        a := true
    if a and debug
        line.new(bar_index,low,bar_index,high,extend = extend.both)
    a


// known  fvgs: long and short
var array<FVG> lfvgs = array.new<FVG>()
var array<FVG> sfvgs = array.new<FVG>()
var array<FVG> fpfvgs = array.new<FVG>()

// FVG functions =========

//[o1,c1,h1,l1,o2,c2,h2,l2,o3,c3,h3,l3,t2] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, tf, 
//  [open[1], close[1], high[1], low[1], open[2], close[2], high[2], low[2],
//  open[3],close[3],high[3],low[3],time[2]], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)


clearlastfp(array<FVG> fpfvgs) =>
    while fpfvgs.size() > nfp
        f = fpfvgs.shift()
        if not na(f) and f.isfp
            if not na(f.rect)
                f.rect.set_extend(extend.none)
            if not na(f.celine)
                f.celine.set_extend(extend.none)
            if not na(f.hiln)
                f.hiln.set_extend(extend.none)
            if not na(f.loln)
                f.loln.set_extend(extend.none)
            f.isfp := false
            f.kill()

isLongFVG(l1,h3) =>
    l1 > h3
longFVGHL(o1,c1,l1,o2,c2,o3,c3,h3) =>
    hi = l1
    lo = h3
    blow1 = math.min(o1,c1)
    bhi2 = math.max(o2,c2)
    blow2 = math.min(o2,c2)
    bhi3 = math.max(o3,c3)
    // include suspension blocks
    fhi = hi
    flo = lo
    if bhi3 < blow2 and not poorLiq
        lo := bhi3
    if blow1 > bhi2 and not poorLiq
        hi := blow1
    [hi,lo, fhi, flo]

isShortFVG(h1,l3) =>
    h1 < l3
shortFVGHL(o1,c1,h1,o2,c2,o3,c3,l3) =>
    hi = l3
    lo = h1
    blow3 = math.min(o3,c3)
    bhi2 = math.max(o2,c2)
    blow2 = math.min(o2,c2)
    bhi1 = math.max(o1,c1)
    // include suspension blocks
    fhi = hi
    flo = lo
    if blow3 > bhi2 and not poorLiq
        hi := blow3
    if bhi1 < blow2 and not poorLiq
        lo := bhi1
    [hi, lo, fhi, flo]

// 1PFVG from the 1m candles (charts above 1m and below 15m)
// (simple: also selects the timeframe of request.security_lower_tf)
bool fpLowTf = fp1m and timeframe.isminutes and timeframe.in_seconds() > 60 and timeframe.in_seconds() < 900
bool fpLow = dofp and fpLowTf

isFPFVG() =>
    r = dofp
    if r
        h = hour(time,tz)
        m = minute(time,tz)
        nmin = 2
        if timeframe.isminutes
            nmin := tfsecs/60 * 2
        r := h == fph and m > fpm+nmin and timeframe.isminutes and tfsecs/60 <=3 and not fpLow
    r
if bar_index == 0
    log.info("fpfvg h {0} fpfvgm {1}", fph, fpm)

eqFVG(a,b) =>
    a.hi == b.hi and a.lo == b.lo and a.idx == b.idx

method endsAt(FVG f) =>
    na(f.end) ? time : f.end

method isDone(FVG f, o, c) =>
    f.islong ? (c < f.lo or o < f.lo) : (c>f.hi or o > f.hi)


method bgColor(FVG f) =>
    c = f.islong ? lcol : scol
    if f.isfp
        c := fpcol
        if f.iswfp
            c := wfpcol
        else if f.isffp
            c := ffpcol
    if f.isifp
        c := ifpcol
    bool hid = hideReg and (ifvgOnly or (not f.isfp and not f.isifp))
    // [REL] too small for a C.E.: a little more transparent
    if false
        c := color.new(c, color.t(c) + (100 - color.t(c)) / 2)
    styNoFill ? color(na) : (hid ? color.new(c, 100) : c)
    

method lnColor(FVG f) =>
    c = f.islong ? lnlcol : lnscol
    if f.isfp
        c := lnfpcol
        if f.iswfp
            c := lnwfpcol
        else if f.isffp
            c := lnffpcol
    if f.isifp
        c := ilnfpcol
    bool hid = hideReg and (ifvgOnly or (not f.isfp and not f.isifp))
    // [REL] too small for a C.E.: no border (boxes only; segments are the lines themselves)
    hid or (false and not stySeg) ? color.new(c, 100) : c

// IFVG boxes: the FVG box itself is turned into the IFVG box (no second box on the same place) ====
var array<FVG> keptIf = array.new<FVG>()   // FVGs whose box is currently shown as IFVG

// back to the plain FVG, as it was before becoming an IFVG
method restore(FVG f) =>
    f.kept := false
    f.cand := false
    if not na(f.rect)
        if f.own or stySeg
            f.rect.delete()
            f.rect := na
            f.own := false
        else
            f.rect.set_bgcolor(f.bgColor())
            f.rect.set_border_color(f.lnColor())
            f.rect.set_border_width(1)
            f.rect.set_text(fvgLbl(f))
            f.rect.set_right(f.endsAt())
            f.rect.set_extend((f.isifp or f.isfp) ? extend.right : extend.none)
    true

// the (older) FVG that absorbed a duplicate is the one that is shown
method adopt(FVG fv, int dir) =>
    FVG f = na(fv.dup) ? fv : fv.dup
    if not f.kept
        keptIf.push(f)
    f.kept := true
    f.cand := true
    f.kdir := dir
    f.rect

// the IFVG candidate is replaced: keep it if confirmed (and wanted), else restore the FVG
method release(FVG fv, bool confirmed, int ctime) =>
    FVG f = na(fv.dup) ? fv : fv.dup
    f.cand := false
    if f.kept
        if keepIFVG and confirmed
            if na(f.end)
                f.end := ctime
            if keptIf.size() > keepMax + 3
                FVG o = keptIf.shift()
                if o.cand
                    keptIf.push(o)
                else
                    o.restore()
        else
            f.restore()
    true

// extend the IFVG boxes; restore kept ones when invalidated (close back through them)
updKept() =>
    int n = keptIf.size()
    if n > 0
        for i = n - 1 to 0
            FVG f = keptIf.get(i)
            if na(f.rect) or not f.kept
                f.kept := false
                f.cand := false
                keptIf.remove(i)
            else if not f.cand and barstate.isconfirmed and (f.kdir < 0 ? close > f.hi : close < f.lo)
                f.restore()
                keptIf.remove(i)
            else
                f.rect.set_right(time)
    true

// widen g (older FVG) with f (new almost identical one): max hi / min lo, for both, and extend g
// (a 1PFVG is never changed by a duplicate: it keeps its zone)
method mergeZone(FVG g, FVG f) =>
    if not g.kept and not g.isfp and not g.isifp
        float nh = math.max(g.hi, f.hi)
        float nl = math.min(g.lo, f.lo)
        g.hi := nh
        g.lo := nl
        g.ce := math.avg(nh, nl)
        f.hi := nh
        f.lo := nl
        f.ce := g.ce
        if not na(g.rect)
            g.rect.set_top(nh)
            g.rect.set_bottom(nl)
        if not na(g.hiln)
            g.hiln.set_y1(nh)
            g.hiln.set_y2(nh)
            g.loln.set_y1(nl)
            g.loln.set_y2(nl)
        if not na(g.celine)
            g.celine.set_y1(g.ce)
            g.celine.set_y2(g.ce)
        g.end := na
        g.ext := true
        bumpTags()
    true

// FVG filtering around liquidity sweeps ==============================================
type FltState
    int post = 1000000      // FVGs shown since the last sweep (starts high: nothing shown before the first sweep)
    float stH = na          // last confirmed short-term high (not swept yet)
    float stL = na
    int stHbar = na
    int stLbar = na

var FltState fs = FltState.new()
var array<FVG> pendF = array.new<FVG>()  // FVGs since the last sweep that are not shown (yet)
var array<FVG> relF = array.new<FVG>()   // [REL] live FVGs not shown (yet)
var array<box> relB = array.new<box>()   // [REL] boxes of the live FVGs near the price (last bar only)
var array<FVG> relS = array.new<FVG>()   // [REL] small drawn FVGs just filled, waiting for the swing check

insertSorted(array<FVG> a, FVG f) =>
    int pos = a.size()
    while pos > 0 and a.get(pos - 1).start > f.start
        pos -= 1
    f.shown := true
    a.insert(pos, f)
    if f.brkD != 0 or f.mbD != 0
        bumpTags()
    true

// older drawn FVG (any bias) that is almost exactly the same zone as f
findDup(FVG f) =>
    FVG r = na
    float tol = (f.hi - f.lo) * dupTol / 100.0
    if dupTol > 0
        // drawn FVGs, first presented ones and FVGs whose box is shown as IFVG (they may not be in the other lists)
        for k = 0 to 3
            array<FVG> arr = k == 0 ? lfvgs : (k == 1 ? sfvgs : (k == 2 ? fpfvgs : keptIf))
            int n = arr.size()
            if n > 0
                for i = n - 1 to 0
                    FVG g = arr.get(i)
                    if math.abs(g.hi - f.hi) <= tol and math.abs(g.lo - f.lo) <= tol and (na(r) or g.start > r.start)
                        r := g
                        break
    r

method route(FltState s, FVG f) =>
    FVG d = findDup(f)
    bool shown = false
    if not na(d)
        // extend the old FVG instead of adding the new one; the new FVG keeps feeding the IFVG logic.
        // A 1PFVG is never changed by a duplicate: it keeps its zone
        f.dup := d
        d.mergeZone(f)
    else if fltOff
        shown := true
    else if s.post < flN
        shown := true
        s.post += 1
    if shown
        insertSorted(f.islong ? lfvgs : sfvgs, f)
    else if na(d)
        pendF.push(f)
        if pendF.size() > 60
            pendF.shift()
        if fltRel
            relF.push(f)
            if relF.size() > 300
                relF.shift()
    true

// show a pending FVG: if a drawn one is almost the same zone, merge into it instead of drawing a second box
reveal(FVG f) =>
    FVG d = f.kept ? na : findDup(f)
    if na(d)
        insertSorted(f.islong ? lfvgs : sfvgs, f)
    else
        f.dup := d
        // a 1PFVG keeps its zone and start
        if f.start < d.start and not d.kept and not d.isfp and not d.isifp
            // the revealed FVG is the older one: the merged box starts where it started
            d.start := f.start
            if not na(d.rect)
                d.rect.set_left(d.start)
            if not na(d.hiln)
                d.hiln.set_x1(d.start)
                d.loln.set_x1(d.start)
            if not na(d.celine)
                d.celine.set_x1(d.start)
        d.mergeZone(f)
    true

// a sweep happened: reveal the last FVG before it (and, optionally, the most significant one near the middle of the arm)
onSweep() =>
    int n = pendF.size()
    if n > 0
        FVG lastF = pendF.get(n - 1)
        // [REL] the last FVG before the sweep waits to become an IFVG
        if fltRel
            lastF.swp := true
            lastF := na
        FVG midF = na
        if not na(lastF)
            reveal(lastF)
        if not na(midF)
            reveal(midF)
        pendF.clear()
    true

// [DE] Delivery Engine =========================================================
// displacement: candle range vs. its standard deviation (TFO criterion of the Delivery Engine)
float deRange = deDispType == "Open to Close" ? math.abs(open - close) : high - low
float deStd = ta.stdev(deRange, deStdLen) * deStdX
bool deDispOK = deRange[2] > deStd[2]   // middle candle of the FVG detected on this bar
// the middle candle of a displacement FVG (detected one candle later, hence the offset)
bool deDispFvg = deRange[1] > deStd[1] and (close[1] > open[1] ? high[2] < low : low[2] > high)
barcolor(deDispBar and deDispFvg ? deDispCol : na, offset = -1)
float deStdMss = ta.stdev(deRange, deStdLen) * deMssX
bool deDispUp = nz(ta.barssince(deRange > deStdMss and close > open), 999) <= deMssWin
bool deDispDn = nz(ta.barssince(deRange > deStdMss and close < open), 999) <= deMssWin

// killzones (ICTlevels sessions) in the 1PFVG time zone; ignored above 15m
bool deUS = tz != "Europe/Madrid"
bool deInKz = not na(time(timeframe.period, deUS ? "2000-0000" : "2300-0600", tz))
     or not na(time(timeframe.period, deUS ? "0200-0500" : "0800-1300", tz))
     or not na(time(timeframe.period, deUS ? "0700-1130" : "1330-1800", tz))
     or not na(time(timeframe.period, deUS ? "1330-1600" : "1900-2200", tz))
bool deKzOK = not deKz or not timeframe.isintraday or tfsecs > 900 or deInKz

// HTF structure: 1 after a close above the last swing high, -1 after a close below the last swing low
deStruct(int len) =>
    var float sh = na
    var float sl = na
    var int d = 0
    float ph = ta.pivothigh(high, len, len)
    float pl = ta.pivotlow(low, len, len)
    if not na(sh) and close > sh
        d := 1
        sh := na
    if not na(sl) and close < sl
        d := -1
        sl := na
    if not na(ph)
        sh := ph
    if not na(pl)
        sl := pl
    d
bool deHtfUse = deHtfOn and timeframe.in_seconds(deHtf) > tfsecs
int deHtfDir = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, deHtfUse ? deHtf : timeframe.period, deStruct(deLiqLen)[1],
     lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)
bool deHtfUp = not deHtfUse or nz(deHtfDir) == 1
bool deHtfDn = not deHtfUse or nz(deHtfDir) == -1

// swing liquidity (BSL / SSL) not taken yet, and its sweeps
float dePH = ta.pivothigh(high, deLiqLen, deLiqLen)
float dePL = ta.pivotlow(low, deLiqLen, deLiqLen)
var array<float> deBsl = array.new<float>()
var array<float> deSsl = array.new<float>()
var int deLastBsl = na   // bar of the last sweep of a swing high
var int deLastSsl = na
if deBsl.size() > 0
    for i = deBsl.size() - 1 to 0
        if high > deBsl.get(i)
            deBsl.remove(i)
            deLastBsl := bar_index
if deSsl.size() > 0
    for i = deSsl.size() - 1 to 0
        if low < deSsl.get(i)
            deSsl.remove(i)
            deLastSsl := bar_index
bool deSslRecent = not na(deLastSsl) and bar_index - deLastSsl <= deSeqWin
bool deBslRecent = not na(deLastBsl) and bar_index - deLastBsl <= deSeqWin


// structure of the chart (swings of deMssLen): MSS = break of the last swing against the structure with
// displacement, or a break with displacement in the direction of a recent CHoCH (break without displacement)
float deMPH = ta.pivothigh(high, deMssLen, deMssLen)
float deMPL = ta.pivotlow(low, deMssLen, deMssLen)
var float deShP = na
var float deSlP = na
var int deDir = 0
var int deChochUp = na     // bar of the last CHoCH up, while it can still be upgraded to an MSS
var int deChochDn = na
if not na(deShP) and close > deShP
    bool isRev = deDir != 1
    bool upg = not isRev and not na(deChochUp) and bar_index - deChochUp <= deSeqWin and deDispUp
    bool isMss = (isRev or upg) and deDispUp
    if isMss
        deChochUp := na
    else if isRev
        deChochUp := bar_index
    deChochDn := na
    deDir := 1
    deShP := na
if not na(deSlP) and close < deSlP
    bool isRev = deDir != -1
    bool upg = not isRev and not na(deChochDn) and bar_index - deChochDn <= deSeqWin and deDispDn
    bool isMss = (isRev or upg) and deDispDn
    if isMss
        deChochDn := na
    else if isRev
        deChochDn := bar_index
    deChochUp := na
    deDir := -1
    deSlP := na
if not na(deMPH)
    deShP := deMPH
if not na(deMPL)
    deSlP := deMPL
if not na(dePH)
    deBsl.push(dePH)
    if deBsl.size() > 50
        deBsl.shift()
if not na(dePL)
    deSsl.push(dePL)
    if deSsl.size() > 50
        deSsl.shift()

// IFVG label: sign, inversion count, OTE (and its timeframes), A+
ifvgTxt(int d, int inv, bool ote, string tags, bool ap, int mbd) =>
    string t = "IFVG" + (lblSign ? (d < 0 ? "-" : "+") : "")
    if inv > 1
        t += " ×" + str.tostring(inv)
    if ote
        t += " OTE" + (lblTf and tags != "" ? " " + tags : "")
    if ap and lblAp
        t += " A+"
    if mbd != 0 and mbd == d
        t += mbd > 0 ? " ↑" : " ↓"
    t

// [MB] arrow direction of an IFVG's FVG
mbOf(FVG f) =>
    na(f) ? 0 : f.mbD

// confirmation of a close (or full body) through an FVG
upBreak(float hi) =>
    deConf == "Full body" ? math.min(open, close) > hi : close > hi
dnBreak(float lo) =>
    deConf == "Full body" ? math.max(open, close) < lo : close < lo

var hasfp = false
var hasifp = false
var fpKept = false // [1PF] today's 1PFVG passed the 1PFVG filter (an inverse 1PFVG may follow it)
if hour(time,tz) != fph
    hasfp := false
    hasifp := false
    fpKept := false
timeat(int n) =>
    time[-n]
FVG lastlongfvg = na
FVG lastshortfvg = na
if true
    [hi, lo, fhi, flo] = longFVGHL(open[1], close[1], low[1], open[2],
         close[2], open[3], close[3], high[3])
    // [PL] poor liquidity: two up-close candles in a row with a gap make an FVG (as if one more was between)
    int fk = 3
    if poorLiq and not (fhi - flo > minfvg) and close[1] > open[1] and close[2] > open[2] and low[1] > high[2]
        hi := low[1]
        lo := high[2]
        fhi := hi
        flo := lo
        fk := 2
    if fhi - flo > minfvg and fhi-flo < maxfvg and (not deDisp or deDispOK or isFPFVG() or (not hasifp and hasfp and fpKept and doifp and not fpLow))
        f = FVG.new(hi,lo,math.avg(hi,lo),true,timeat(-fk))
        f.sbar := bar_index - fk // [OTE]
        f.aplus := false // [DE] A+ off
        f.disp := deDispOK // [DE]
        lastlongfvg := f
        if not hasifp and hasfp and fpKept and doifp and not fpLow
            fp = fpfvgs.last()
            if fp.islong != f.islong
                f.isifp := true
                hasifp := true
                fpfvgs.push(f)
        bool fpNow = not hasfp and isFPFVG() and not f.isifp
        if fpNow
            hasfp := true
        if fpNow and fpPass(dayofweek)
            f.isfp := true
            f.iswfp := dayofweek == dayofweek.monday
            f.isffp := dayofweek == dayofweek.friday
            fpKept := true
            fpfvgs.push(f)
            clearlastfp(fpfvgs)
        else if not fponly and not f.isifp and (not deDisp or deDispOK)
            fs.route(f)
        else
            f.kill()
if true
    [hi, lo, fhi, flo] = shortFVGHL(open[1], close[1], high[1], open[2],
         close[2], open[3], close[3], low[3])
    // [PL] poor liquidity: two down-close candles in a row with a gap make an FVG (as if one more was between)
    int fk = 3
    if poorLiq and not (fhi - flo > minfvg) and close[1] < open[1] and close[2] < open[2] and high[1] < low[2]
        hi := low[2]
        lo := high[1]
        fhi := hi
        flo := lo
        fk := 2
    if fhi - flo > minfvg and fhi - flo < maxfvg and (not deDisp or deDispOK or isFPFVG() or (not hasifp and hasfp and fpKept and doifp and not fpLow))
        f = FVG.new(hi,lo,math.avg(hi,lo),false,timeat(-fk))
        f.sbar := bar_index - fk // [OTE]
        f.aplus := false // [DE] A+ off
        f.disp := deDispOK // [DE]
        lastshortfvg := f
        if not hasifp and hasfp and fpKept and doifp and not fpLow
            fp = fpfvgs.last()
            if fp.islong != f.islong
                f.isifp := true
                hasifp := true
                fpfvgs.push(f)
        bool fpNow = not hasfp and isFPFVG() and not f.isifp
        if fpNow
            hasfp := true
        if fpNow and fpPass(dayofweek)
            f.isfp := true
            f.iswfp := dayofweek == dayofweek.monday
            f.isffp := dayofweek == dayofweek.friday
            fpKept := true
            fpfvgs.push(f)
            clearlastfp(fpfvgs)
        else if not fponly and not f.isifp and (not deDisp or deDispOK)
            fs.route(f)
        else 
            f.kill()

// 1PFVG from the 1m candles: the 1m candles of this chart bar, in order, each one tested as candle [0] of
// isFPFVG on the 1m chart (candles [1] to [3] are the three before it)
[l1t, l1o, l1h, l1l, l1c] = request.security_lower_tf(syminfo.tickerid, fpLowTf ? "1" : timeframe.period,
     [time, open, high, low, close])
var array<float> fpO = array.new<float>()
var array<float> fpH = array.new<float>()
var array<float> fpL = array.new<float>()
var array<float> fpC = array.new<float>()
var array<int> fpT = array.new<int>()
var int fpLastT = na
if fpLow and barstate.isconfirmed and not na(l1t) and l1t.size() > 0
    for j = 0 to l1t.size() - 1
        int t0 = l1t.get(j)
        if na(fpLastT) or t0 > fpLastT
            fpLastT := t0
            fpO.push(l1o.get(j))
            fpH.push(l1h.get(j))
            fpL.push(l1l.get(j))
            fpC.push(l1c.get(j))
            fpT.push(t0)
            if fpT.size() > 4
                fpO.shift()
                fpH.shift()
                fpL.shift()
                fpC.shift()
                fpT.shift()
            bool fpWin = not hasfp and minute(t0, tz) > fpm + 2
            bool ifpWin = hasfp and fpKept and doifp and not hasifp and fpfvgs.size() > 0
            if fpT.size() == 4 and hour(t0, tz) == fph and (fpWin or ifpWin)
                // index 2: candle [1], 1: [2], 0: [3]
                [lhi, llo, lfhi, lflo] = longFVGHL(fpO.get(2), fpC.get(2), fpL.get(2), fpO.get(1),
                     fpC.get(1), fpO.get(0), fpC.get(0), fpH.get(0))
                [shi, slo, sfhi, sflo] = shortFVGHL(fpO.get(2), fpC.get(2), fpH.get(2), fpO.get(1),
                     fpC.get(1), fpO.get(0), fpC.get(0), fpL.get(0))
                bool isL = lfhi - lflo > minfvg and lfhi - lflo < maxfvg
                bool isS = sfhi - sflo > minfvg and sfhi - sflo < maxfvg
                if ifpWin
                    // inverse 1PFVG: the first 1m FVG of the opposite bias after the 1PFVG
                    bool fpLong = fpfvgs.last().islong
                    isL := isL and not fpLong
                    isS := isS and fpLong
                if (isL or isS) and not ifpWin and not fpPass(dayofweek(t0, tz))
                    hasfp := true // [1PF] the day's 1PFVG, filtered out
                else if isL or isS
                    FVG f = isL ? FVG.new(lhi, llo, math.avg(lhi, llo), true, fpT.get(0))
                         : FVG.new(shi, slo, math.avg(shi, slo), false, fpT.get(0))
                    f.sbar := bar_index
                    if ifpWin
                        f.isifp := true
                        hasifp := true
                        fpfvgs.push(f)
                    else
                        f.isfp := true
                        f.iswfp := dayofweek(t0, tz) == dayofweek.monday
                        f.isffp := dayofweek(t0, tz) == dayofweek.friday
                        hasfp := true
                        fpKept := true
                        fpfvgs.push(f)
                        clearlastfp(fpfvgs)

updfvgs(array<FVG> fvgs) =>
    if fvgs.size() > 0
        for i = 0 to fvgs.size()-1
            f = fvgs.get(i)
            // [PERF] a finished FVG whose drawings already end at its end needs no more work (a merge resets
            // end, and a kill clears the drawings, so those are redone)
            if not na(f.end)
                continue
            isdone = not na(f.end)
            // check if filled
            if not isdone and f.isDone(open,close)
                f.end := f.endsAt()
                // [REL] small FVG filled: hidden later unless it formed at a swing
                if false and not f.swp and not f.ext and not f.kept and not f.cand
                    f.dbar := bar_index
                    relS.push(f)
            if dofvgalert and na(f.end) and barstate.isconfirmed
                f.alerts()
        if fvgs.size() >= maxfvgs  and fvgs.size() > 0
            df = fvgs.shift()
            df.kill()

// FVG filter: liquidity sweeps ===================================
float fPH = ta.pivothigh(high, flL, flR)
float fPL = ta.pivotlow(low, flL, flR)
if not fltOff
    // sweeps are tested against the levels known BEFORE this bar
    if not na(fs.stH) and high > fs.stH
        onSweep()  // arm = from the last short-term low to the sweep
        fs.post := 0
        fs.stH := na
    if not na(fs.stL) and low < fs.stL
        onSweep()  // arm = from the last short-term high to the sweep
        fs.post := 0
        fs.stL := na
    if not na(fPH)
        fs.stH := fPH
        fs.stHbar := bar_index - flR
    if not na(fPL)
        fs.stL := fPL
        fs.stLbar := bar_index - flR

// [REL] "relevant" filter: live FVGs not shown yet ===============
float relAtr = ta.atr(atrLen)
// recent relevant: relF is in creation order, so the old ones are at its front
if fltRecent
    while relF.size() > 0 and bar_index - nz(relF.first().sbar, bar_index) > relMaxAge
        relF.shift()
if fltRel and barstate.isconfirmed and relF.size() > 0
    for i = relF.size() - 1 to 0
        FVG f = relF.get(i)
        if f.shown or not na(f.dup)
            relF.remove(i)
        else if f.isDone(open, close)
            // the last FVG before a sweep, closed through after it: an IFVG, shown up to the close
            if f.swp
                f.end := time
                reveal(f)
            relF.remove(i)
if fltRel and barstate.islast
    // live FVGs near the price: redrawn on each update of the last bar
    while relB.size() > 0
        relB.pop().delete()
    float rng = nz(relAtr) * minATR
    for f in relF
        if not f.shown and na(f.dup) and na(f.end) and relB.size() < 40
            float dist = close > f.hi ? close - f.hi : close < f.lo ? f.lo - close : 0.0
            if dist <= rng
                relB.push(box.new(f.start, f.hi, time, f.lo, xloc = xloc.bar_time,
                     bgcolor = f.bgColor(), border_color = f.lnColor(), border_width = 1,
                     border_style = line.style_solid, text = fvgLbl(f), text_size = ifvgtsz,
                     text_halign = ifvgha, text_valign = ifvgva))

if not visible and barstate.isnew
    updfvgs(lfvgs)
    updfvgs(sfvgs)
    updfvgs(fpfvgs)
else if true
    if time < chart.right_visible_bar_time + (chart.right_visible_bar_time-chart.left_visible_bar_time)
        updfvgs(lfvgs)
        updfvgs(sfvgs)
        updfvgs(fpfvgs)

// [OTE] prior leg detection =====================================
// Pivot sets: one for the chart timeframe and one for each of the next two higher timeframes.
// HTF pivots come from request.security (non-repainting: confirmed HTF bars only) and are
// stored with the CHART bar index they map to, so legs can be measured on chart candles.

tfName(string s) =>
    float m = str.tonumber(s)
    string r = s
    if not na(m)
        r := m >= 60 and m % 60 == 0 ? str.tostring(m / 60, "#") + "h" : str.tostring(m, "#") + "m"
    else if s == "1D"
        r := "D"
    r

type PivSet
    array<int> hb       // pivot-high chart bar index
    array<float> hp     // pivot-high price
    array<int> lb       // pivot-low chart bar index
    array<float> lp     // pivot-low price
    string tag = ""     // timeframe label
    bool htf = false    // higher timeframe set?

method addHigh(PivSet ps, int b, float p) =>
    ps.hb.push(b)
    ps.hp.push(p)
    if ps.hb.size() > 60
        ps.hb.shift()
        ps.hp.shift()

method addLow(PivSet ps, int b, float p) =>
    ps.lb.push(b)
    ps.lp.push(p)
    if ps.lb.size() > 60
        ps.lb.shift()
        ps.lp.shift()

method lastHigh(PivSet ps) =>
    ps.hp.size() > 0 ? ps.hp.last() : na

method lastLow(PivSet ps) =>
    ps.lp.size() > 0 ? ps.lp.last() : na

var PivSet pv0 = PivSet.new(array.new<int>(), array.new<float>(), array.new<int>(), array.new<float>(), "", false)
var PivSet pv1 = PivSet.new(array.new<int>(), array.new<float>(), array.new<int>(), array.new<float>(), "", true)
var PivSet pv2 = PivSet.new(array.new<int>(), array.new<float>(), array.new<int>(), array.new<float>(), "", true)

// --- chart timeframe pivots
float oph = ta.pivothigh(high, pivL, pivR)
float opl = ta.pivotlow(low, pivL, pivR)
pv0.tag := tfName(timeframe.period)
if not na(oph)
    pv0.addHigh(bar_index - pivR, oph)
if not na(opl)
    pv0.addLow(bar_index - pivR, opl)

// [REL] small filled FVGs: once a pivot at its candles would be confirmed, hide it if there is none and it
// was not extended by a merged FVG (or became an IFVG box) meanwhile
hasPiv(array<int> bars, int b0, int b1) =>
    bool r = false
    int n = bars.size()
    if n > 0
        for k = n - 1 to 0
            int b = bars.get(k)
            if b < b0
                break
            if b <= b1
                r := true
                break
    r

relHide(FVG f) =>
    array<FVG> arr = f.islong ? lfvgs : sfvgs
    int n = arr.size()
    if n > 0
        for k = n - 1 to 0
            FVG g = arr.get(k)
            if g.start == f.start and g.hi == f.hi and g.lo == f.lo
                arr.remove(k)
                break
    f.shown := false
    f.kill()

if fltRel and relS.size() > 0
    for i = relS.size() - 1 to 0
        FVG f = relS.get(i)
        if bar_index >= math.max(f.dbar, f.sbar + 3 + pivR)
            relS.remove(i)
            bool keep = f.ext or f.kept or f.cand or not false
                 or hasPiv(pv0.hb, f.sbar - 1, f.sbar + 3) or hasPiv(pv0.lb, f.sbar - 1, f.sbar + 3)
            if not keep
                relHide(f)

// --- higher timeframe ladder: 3m(or lower) -> 5m -> 15m -> 1h -> 4h -> D
// The chart is placed on the highest rung that is <= the chart timeframe, and the next two rungs are used.
float tfmin = tfsecs / 60
var array<int> ladMin = array.from(3, 5, 15, 60, 240, 1440)
var array<string> ladTf = array.from("3", "5", "15", "60", "240", "D")
int ladIdx = 0
for i = 0 to 5
    if ladMin.get(i) <= tfmin
        ladIdx := i
string htf1 = ladIdx + 1 <= 5 ? ladTf.get(ladIdx + 1) : ""
string htf2 = ladIdx + 2 <= 5 ? ladTf.get(ladIdx + 2) : ""
bool hasH1 = oteHtf1 and htf1 != ""
bool hasH2 = oteHtf2 and htf2 != ""
pv1.tag := hasH1 ? tfName(htf1) : ""
pv2.tag := hasH2 ? tfName(htf2) : ""

string rq1 = hasH1 ? htf1 : timeframe.period
string rq2 = hasH2 ? htf2 : timeframe.period
[h1ph, h1pl, h1pt] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, rq1,
    [ta.pivothigh(high, oteHtfL, oteHtfR)[1], ta.pivotlow(low, oteHtfL, oteHtfR)[1], time[oteHtfR + 1]],
    lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)
[h2ph, h2pl, h2pt] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, rq2,
    [ta.pivothigh(high, oteHtfL, oteHtfR)[1], ta.pivotlow(low, oteHtfL, oteHtfR)[1], time[oteHtfR + 1]],
    lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)
h1chg = ta.change(h1pt)
h2chg = ta.change(h2pt)

// chart bar index of the chart candle that opens at (or right before) time t
barOfTime(int t) =>
    int r = na
    int mx = math.min(bar_index, 4900)
    for k = 0 to mx
        if time[k] <= t
            r := bar_index - k
            break
    r

// a new HTF pivot is registered once, on the first chart bar after its HTF bar closed
feedHtf(PivSet ps, float ph, float pl, int pt, bool evt) =>
    if evt and (not na(ph) or not na(pl))
        int b = barOfTime(pt)
        if not na(b)
            if not na(ph)
                ps.addHigh(b, ph)
            if not na(pl)
                ps.addLow(b, pl)

if doifvg and useOTE
    feedHtf(pv1, h1ph, h1pl, h1pt, hasH1 and not na(h1chg) and h1chg != 0)
    feedHtf(pv2, h2ph, h2pl, h2pt, hasH2 and not na(h2chg) and h2chg != 0)

// Returns [legHigh, legLow] of the leg that precedes the FVG starting at bar sbar.
//   dir = -1 (bearish IFVG, from a bullish FVG): prior DOWN leg = last pivot high before sbar -> lowest low up to sbar
//   dir = +1 (bullish IFVG, from a bearish FVG): prior UP leg   = last pivot low before sbar  -> highest high up to sbar
priorLeg(int dir, int sbar, PivSet ps) =>
    float h = na
    float l = na
    if dir == -1
        int n = ps.hb.size()
        if n > 0
            for i = n - 1 to 0
                int hb = ps.hb.get(i)
                if hb < sbar and bar_index - hb < 4000
                    float lo = low[bar_index - hb]
                    for k = hb to sbar
                        lo := math.min(lo, low[bar_index - k])
                    h := ps.hp.get(i)
                    l := lo
                    break
    else
        int n = ps.lb.size()
        if n > 0
            for i = n - 1 to 0
                int lb = ps.lb.get(i)
                if lb < sbar and bar_index - lb < 4000
                    float hi = high[bar_index - lb]
                    for k = lb to sbar
                        hi := math.max(hi, high[bar_index - k])
                    l := ps.lp.get(i)
                    h := hi
                    break
    [h, l]

// [OTE] tracker =================================================
// One tracker follows one IFVG under watch, against the pivots of ONE timeframe (chart, HTF1 or HTF2).
//   dir = -1 : bearish IFVG (bullish FVG closed through to the downside).
//   dir = +1 : bullish IFVG (bearish FVG closed through to the upside).
// Two OTE checks, both done per timeframe:
//   (1) rejection: the confirming candle wicks into the 0.62-0.79 band of the PRIOR leg (before the FVG)
//   (2) retrace  : after the inversion, price retraces into the IFVG while the IFVG matches the OTE band of
//                  the leg swing -> lowest low (bearish) / swing -> highest high (bullish) since confirmation.
//                  On higher timeframes the swing origin is the latest HTF pivot (if beyond the retrace extreme).
type OteTrack
    int dir = 0
    float zlo = na      // IFVG low
    float zhi = na      // IFVG high
    float legHi = na
    float legLo = na
    float rext = na     // running retrace extreme since the FVG (high for dir -1, low for dir +1)
    bool armed = false  // IFVG confirmed by a close through it
    bool fired = false  // OTE signal already fired for this confirmation
    int ctime = na      // confirmation time
    int cbar = na       // confirmation bar index
    box band = na       // OTE band drawn (leg created after the inversion)
    float pHi = na      // prior leg high (leg before the FVG)
    float pLo = na      // prior leg low
    int sbar = na       // bar index where the FVG starts
    bool rejHit = false // confirming candle rejected the OTE of the prior leg
    box rej = na        // prior-leg OTE band drawn
    string tag = ""     // timeframe label
    int col = 0         // margin column of its timeframe (chart, then each higher timeframe)

// first bar of the OTE bands of t: one column per timeframe, so the bands and labels of several
// timeframes do not overlap
oteX0(OteTrack t) =>
    bar_index + oteOffset + t.col * (oteWidth + 1)

// new IFVG candidate under watch (not yet confirmed). origin = retrace extreme since the FVG
method oteStart(OteTrack t, int dir, float zlo, float zhi, float origin, int sbar, PivSet ps) =>
    box.delete(t.band)
    t.band := na
    box.delete(t.rej)
    t.rej := na
    t.rejHit := false
    t.sbar := sbar
    t.tag := ps.tag
    [pgh, pgl] = priorLeg(dir, sbar, ps)
    t.pHi := pgh
    t.pLo := pgl
    float o = origin
    if ps.htf
        float adj = dir == -1 ? ps.lastHigh() : ps.lastLow()
        if not na(adj)
            o := dir == -1 ? math.max(origin, adj) : math.min(origin, adj)
    t.dir := dir
    t.zlo := zlo
    t.zhi := zhi
    t.armed := false
    t.fired := false
    t.ctime := na
    t.rext := origin
    t.legHi := dir == -1 ? o : na
    t.legLo := dir == 1 ? o : na

// close through the FVG: the IFVG is confirmed, the leg starts being measured
method oteConfirm(OteTrack t) =>
    if t.dir != 0 and not t.armed
        // rejection of the OTE of the PRIOR leg by the confirming candle
        if useOTE and oteRej and not na(t.pHi) and not na(t.pLo) and t.pHi > t.pLo
            float pr = t.pHi - t.pLo
            float ext = na
            float rLo = na
            float rHi = na
            bool hit = false
            if t.dir == -1
                // prior down leg: OTE band is above the leg low; wick must reach up into it
                ext := oteRejAny ? math.max(t.rext, high) : high
                rLo := t.pLo + oteMin * pr
                rHi := t.pLo + oteMax * pr
                hit := ext >= rLo and ext <= (oteRejCap ? rHi : t.pHi) and close <= rHi
            else
                // prior up leg: OTE band is below the leg high; wick must reach down into it
                ext := oteRejAny ? math.min(t.rext, low) : low
                rLo := t.pHi - oteMax * pr
                rHi := t.pHi - oteMin * pr
                hit := ext <= rHi and ext >= (oteRejCap ? rLo : t.pLo) and close >= rLo
            if hit
                t.rejHit := true
                if showOTEband
                    t.rej := box.new(oteX0(t), rHi, oteX0(t) + oteWidth, rLo,
                        xloc = xloc.bar_index,
                        bgcolor = oteBandCol,
                        border_color = oteHighlight,
                        border_style = line.style_dashed,
                        border_width = 1,
                        text = t.tag + " OTE" + (t.dir == 1 ? " ↑" : " ↓"),
                        text_size = size.small,
                        text_color = oteTextCol,
                        text_halign = text.align_center)
        t.armed := true
        t.fired := t.rejHit // one OTE signal per IFVG
        t.ctime := time
        t.cbar := bar_index
        if t.dir == -1
            t.legHi := math.max(t.legHi, high)
            t.legLo := low
        else
            t.legLo := math.min(t.legLo, low)
            t.legHi := high

// IFVG invalidated (closed back through it)
method oteCancel(OteTrack t) =>
    box.delete(t.band)
    t.band := na
    box.delete(t.rej)
    t.rej := na
    t.rejHit := false
    t.armed := false
    if t.dir == -1
        t.legLo := na
    else
        t.legHi := na

// A group runs the three trackers (chart, next TF, second TF) on the same IFVG.
// A confirmed OTE on ANY of them is enough to flag the IFVG as an OTE IFVG (once per IFVG).
type OteGroup
    OteTrack t0
    OteTrack t1
    OteTrack t2
    bool flagged = false
    string tags = ""    // timeframes that matched, e.g. "5m+15m"

method gStart(OteGroup g, int dir, float zlo, float zhi, float origin, int sbar) =>
    g.flagged := false
    g.tags := ""
    g.t0.col := 0
    g.t1.col := 1
    g.t2.col := hasH1 ? 2 : 1
    g.t0.oteStart(dir, zlo, zhi, origin, sbar, pv0)
    if hasH1
        g.t1.oteStart(dir, zlo, zhi, origin, sbar, pv1)
    if hasH2
        g.t2.oteStart(dir, zlo, zhi, origin, sbar, pv2)

method gConfirm(OteGroup g) =>
    g.t0.oteConfirm()
    g.t1.oteConfirm()
    g.t2.oteConfirm()

method gCancel(OteGroup g) =>
    g.flagged := false
    g.tags := ""
    g.t0.oteCancel()
    g.t1.oteCancel()
    g.t2.oteCancel()

var OteGroup gBear = OteGroup.new(OteTrack.new(), OteTrack.new(), OteTrack.new())  // non-swing mode, bearish IFVG (from last long FVG)
var OteGroup gBull = OteGroup.new(OteTrack.new(), OteTrack.new(), OteTrack.new())  // non-swing mode, bullish IFVG (from last short FVG)
var OteGroup gSw   = OteGroup.new(OteTrack.new(), OteTrack.new(), OteTrack.new())  // swing mode, single IFVG under watch

// highest/lowest of the 4 bars spanning the FVG (3 candles + current bar)
h4 = ta.highest(high, 4)
l4 = ta.lowest(low, 4)

// Close above/below IFVG setups =================================

var box ifvgBox = na // IFVG used when using swings or bullifvg (bear fvg) when not using swings
var box ifvgBoxb = na // when not using swings, bearifvg
var FVG bullifvg = na
var FVG bearifvg = na
var int bullconfirm = na
var int bearconfirm = na
var int bullInv = 0       // [DE] inversions of the bull candidate (-1 invalidated)
var int bearInv = 0
var bool bullAp = false   // [DE] A+ IFVG
var bool bearAp = false
// [IFO] replaced candidates not yet closed through (at most 3 per side). When the candidate of their side is
// confirmed, the ones the same candle closed through are shown as confirmed IFVGs too (box and label only)
var array<FVG> bearOld = array.new<FVG>()
var array<FVG> bullOld = array.new<FVG>()
ifoPush(array<FVG> old, FVG f) =>
    old.push(f)
    if old.size() > 3
        old.shift()
ifoConfirm(array<FVG> old, int d) =>
    for f in old
        if d < 0 ? dnBreak(f.lo) : upBreak(f.hi)
            box b = f.adopt(d)
            if not na(b)
                b.set_text(ifvgTxt(d, 1, false, "", false, mbOf(f)))
            f.release(true, time)
    old.clear()
ifoPurge(array<FVG> old, int d) =>
    int n = old.size()
    if n > 0
        for i = n - 1 to 0
            FVG f = old.get(i)
            if d < 0 ? close < f.lo : close > f.hi
                old.remove(i)
    true

if doifvg and not ifvgswings and not na(lastlongfvg)
    if not na(bearifvg)
        if na(bearconfirm) and bearInv == 0
            ifoPush(bearOld, bearifvg)
        bearifvg.release(not na(bearconfirm), bearconfirm)
    bearifvg := lastlongfvg
    bearconfirm := na
    bearInv := 0
    bearAp := false
    gBear.gStart(-1, bearifvg.lo, bearifvg.hi, h4, bearifvg.sbar) // [OTE]
    ifvgBoxb := bearifvg.adopt(-1)
if doifvg and not ifvgswings and not na(lastshortfvg)
    if not na(bullifvg)
        if na(bullconfirm) and bullInv == 0
            ifoPush(bullOld, bullifvg)
        bullifvg.release(not na(bullconfirm), bullconfirm)
    bullifvg := lastshortfvg
    bullconfirm := na
    bullInv := 0
    bullAp := false
    gBull.gStart(1, bullifvg.lo, bullifvg.hi, l4, bullifvg.sbar) // [OTE]
    ifvgBox := bullifvg.adopt(1)
if not na(ifvgBox) and barstate.isnew
    ifvgBox.set_right(time)
if not na(ifvgBoxb) and barstate.isnew
    ifvgBoxb.set_right(time)

// Possible IFVGs for IFVG setups

// IFVG signals
sig = 0
// 1PFVG (or inverse 1PFVG) zone, or a duplicate merged into one: it keeps its own look
isFp(FVG fv) =>
    FVG f = na(fv) ? na : (na(fv.dup) ? fv : fv.dup)
    not na(f) and (f.isfp or f.isifp)

// [DE] invalidated IFVG: faded (stays as it is, no longer extended) or back to the plain FVG
deKill(FVG fv) =>
    FVG f = na(fv.dup) ? fv : fv.dup
    // a 1PFVG always goes back to its own look
    if deDead == "Back to FVG" or f.isfp or f.isifp
        f.restore()
    else
        f.kept := false
        f.cand := false
        if not na(f.rect)
            f.rect.set_bgcolor(deDeadCol)
            f.rect.set_border_color(deDeadCol)
            f.rect.set_border_width(1)
            f.rect.set_text("")
            f.rect.set_right(time)
    true

// [DE] the box of an inverted zone in direction d
deRecolor(box b, int d, FVG fv) =>
    if not na(b) and not isFp(fv)
        color c = d < 0 ? bearIFVGColor : bullIFVGColor
        b.set_bgcolor(color.new(c, ifvgTrans))
        b.set_border_color(color.new(c, borderTrans))
    true

if doifvg and not ifvgswings and not deInv
    if not na(bullifvg) and not na(bullconfirm) and barstate.isconfirmed and close < bullifvg.lo
        bullconfirm := na
        gBull.gCancel() // [OTE]
        ifvgBox.set_text(na)
    if not na(bullifvg) and barstate.isconfirmed and upBreak(bullifvg.hi) and na(bullconfirm)
        bullconfirm := time
        gBull.gConfirm() // [OTE]
        ifoConfirm(bullOld, 1)
        bullAp := false
        ifvgBox.set_text(ifvgTxt(1, 1, false, "", bullAp, mbOf(bullifvg)))
        sig := 1
    if not na(bearifvg) and not na(bearconfirm) and barstate.isconfirmed and close > bearifvg.hi
        bearconfirm := na
        gBear.gCancel() // [OTE]
        ifvgBoxb.set_text(na)
    if not na(bearifvg) and barstate.isconfirmed and dnBreak(bearifvg.lo) and na(bearconfirm)
        bearAp := false
        ifvgBoxb.set_text(ifvgTxt(-1, 1, false, "", bearAp, mbOf(bearifvg)))
        bearconfirm := time
        gBear.gConfirm() // [OTE]
        ifoConfirm(bearOld, -1)
        sig := -1

// [DE] inversion rules: every close through the zone inverts it again, up to the max; then it is invalidated.
// Bull candidate (bearish FVG): inversions 1, 3, ... are bullish (close above), 2, 4, ... bearish (close below).
if doifvg and not ifvgswings and deInv and barstate.isconfirmed
    if not na(bullifvg) and bullInv >= 0
        bool brk = bullInv % 2 == 0 ? upBreak(bullifvg.hi) : dnBreak(bullifvg.lo)
        if brk
            if bullInv >= deMaxInv
                bullInv := -1
                bullconfirm := na
                gBull.gCancel() // [OTE]
                deKill(bullifvg)
                ifvgBox := na
            else
                bullInv += 1
                int d = bullInv % 2 == 1 ? 1 : -1
                if bullInv == 1
                    bullconfirm := time
                    gBull.gConfirm() // [OTE]
                    ifoConfirm(bullOld, 1)
                else
                    bullconfirm := na
                    gBull.gCancel() // [OTE] only the first inversion
                    deRecolor(ifvgBox, d, bullifvg)
                bullAp := false
                ifvgBox.set_text(ifvgTxt(d, bullInv, false, "", bullAp, mbOf(bullifvg)))
                sig := d
    if not na(bearifvg) and bearInv >= 0
        bool brk = bearInv % 2 == 0 ? dnBreak(bearifvg.lo) : upBreak(bearifvg.hi)
        if brk
            if bearInv >= deMaxInv
                bearInv := -1
                bearconfirm := na
                gBear.gCancel() // [OTE]
                deKill(bearifvg)
                ifvgBoxb := na
            else
                bearInv += 1
                int d = bearInv % 2 == 1 ? -1 : 1
                if bearInv == 1
                    bearconfirm := time
                    gBear.gConfirm() // [OTE]
                    ifoConfirm(bearOld, -1)
                else
                    bearconfirm := na
                    gBear.gCancel() // [OTE] only the first inversion
                    deRecolor(ifvgBoxb, d, bearifvg)
                bearAp := false
                ifvgBoxb.set_text(ifvgTxt(d, bearInv, false, "", bearAp, mbOf(bearifvg)))
                sig := sig == 0 ? d : sig

if doifvg and not ifvgswings and barstate.isconfirmed
    ifoPurge(bearOld, -1)
    ifoPurge(bullOld, 1)
updKept()

// swings as an alternating high / low sequence of the last three pivots, two of a kind merged into
// the more extreme (pr prices, br bars, ty 1 high / -1 low). True when the sequence changed.
blkPivot(array<float> pr, array<int> br, array<int> ty, float price, int bar, int kind) =>
    bool changed = false
    int n = ty.size()
    if n > 0 and ty.get(n - 1) == kind
        if kind == 1 ? price > pr.get(n - 1) : price < pr.get(n - 1)
            pr.set(n - 1, price)
            br.set(n - 1, bar)
            changed := true
    else
        pr.push(price)
        br.push(bar)
        ty.push(kind)
        changed := true
        while ty.size() > 3
            pr.shift()
            br.shift()
            ty.shift()
    changed

// block zone at the swing k0 bars back: the up-close (dir 1) / down-close (dir -1) candle there or among
// the 3 before it, wick to wick (breaker) or its body (mitigation block), plus the consecutive ones before it in
// "Whole sequence" mode
blkZone(int dir, int k0, bool body, bool whole) =>
    float zh = na
    float zl = na
    int zt = na
    int zt1 = na
    if k0 + 3 <= 300
        int k = k0
        while k <= k0 + 3 and na(zt)
            if (close[k] - open[k]) * dir > 0
                zh := body ? math.max(open[k], close[k]) : high[k]
                zl := body ? math.min(open[k], close[k]) : low[k]
                zt := time[k]
                zt1 := time[k]
            k += 1
        if not na(zt) and whole
            while k <= 300 and (close[k] - open[k]) * dir > 0
                zh := math.max(zh, body ? math.max(open[k], close[k]) : high[k])
                zl := math.min(zl, body ? math.min(open[k], close[k]) : low[k])
                zt := time[k]
                k += 1
    [zh, zl, zt, zt1]


// [BRK] Breakers =================================================
type Breaker
    int dir         // 1 bullish (long after the pullback), -1 bearish
    float hi        // zone
    float lo
    int t           // time of the first candle of the zone
    bool broken = false
    int bkBar = na  // bar of the close beyond the zone
    bool swung = false  // a swing beyond the zone formed after the break (needed for the pullback)
    bool tagged = false // first pullback with a matching FVG / IFVG seen
    box bx = na     // drawn at that pullback (when the rectangle is on)
    line ml = na    // mid line
    int t1 = na     // time of the last candle of the zone
    int zb = na     // bar of the last candle of the zone (age)
    int pb = na     // bar of the last pullback into the zone (age once tagged)
    bool won = false // price left the zone in its direction after a pullback
    array<line> fl = na // flagged candles (wick and body lines)

var array<Breaker> brks = array.new<Breaker>()
float bPH = ta.pivothigh(high, brkLen, brkLen)
float bPL = ta.pivotlow(low, brkLen, brkLen)
var array<float> bSqP = array.new<float>()  // swing sequence (ICTblocks)
var array<int> bSqB = array.new<int>()
var array<int> bSqT = array.new<int>()
var float bUpLvl = na  // swing high waiting for a close above it (bullish), its bar, the last one used
var int bUpBar = na
var int bUpDone = na
var float bDnLvl = na  // swing low waiting for a close below it (bearish)
var int bDnBar = na
var int bDnDone = na

// ICTblocks: the breaker is drawn from its break on, lighter, growing while it waits for the pullback;
// erased when it is dropped before the pullback (failed, too old or one too many)
brkWait(Breaker b) =>
    if brkBox or brkShd
        b.bx := box.new(b.t, b.hi, time, b.lo, xloc = xloc.bar_time,
            border_color = brkShd ? color.new(color.gray, 100) : brkC(b.dir), border_style = brkSty,
            border_width = brkShd ? 0 : brkW, bgcolor = color.new(brkShd ? color.gray : brkC(b.dir), brkShd ? 88 : (brkNoFill ? 100 : 93)),
            text = b.dir == 1 ? "B↑" : "B↓", text_color = brkC(b.dir), text_size = size.small,
            text_halign = brkLblH, text_valign = brkLblV)
        b.ml := line.new(b.t, (b.hi + b.lo) / 2, time, (b.hi + b.lo) / 2, xloc = xloc.bar_time, color = brkC(b.dir),
            style = brkSty, width = brkW)
    true
brkDrop(Breaker b) =>
    if not b.tagged and not na(b.bx)
        b.bx.delete()
        b.ml.delete()
    true

brkAdd(int dir, float zh, float zl, int zt, int zt1) =>
    int zk = 0
    while zk < 300 and time[zk] > zt1
        zk += 1
    brks.push(Breaker.new(dir, zh, zl, zt, t1 = zt1, zb = bar_index - zk))
    int cnt = 0
    for b in brks
        if b.dir == dir
            cnt += 1
    if cnt > brkKeep
        for i = 0 to brks.size() - 1
            if brks.get(i).dir == dir
                brkDrop(brks.remove(i))
                break
    true

// FVG shown as the box of a confirmed IFVG (close mode or swing mode), with its IFVG label
sameF(FVG f, FVG g) =>
    FVG h = na(g) ? g : (na(g.dup) ? g : g.dup)
    not na(h) and h.start == f.start and h.hi == f.hi and h.lo == f.lo and h.islong == f.islong

confIfvg(FVG f) =>
    (not na(bullconfirm) and sameF(f, bullifvg)) or (not na(bearconfirm) and sameF(f, bearifvg))

// breaker b drawn up to this candle when FVG / IFVG f overlaps it on the pullback (once); ib: the IFVG box
// when f is the confirmed IFVG (its label turns bold), else na (a plain unlabeled FVG gets B↑ / B↓)
brkTag(FVG f, Breaker b, box ib) =>
    if not na(f) and f.hi >= b.lo and f.lo <= b.hi
        f.brk := true
        f.brkD := b.dir
        bumpTags()
        if not na(ib)
            ib.set_text_formatting(text.format_bold)
        else
            // the label direction is kept for when the box shows the plain FVG label (also after it was an
            // IFVG candidate); an unconfirmed IFVG candidate box shows it too
            f.lblD := b.dir
            if na(f.end) and (not f.kept or (f.cand and not confIfvg(f))) and not (f.aplus and lblAp) and not na(f.rect)
                f.rect.set_text(fvgLbl(f))
                f.rect.set_text_size(ifvgtsz)
                f.rect.set_text_halign(ifvgha)
                f.rect.set_text_valign(ifvgva)
        float mid = (b.hi + b.lo) / 2
        if not b.tagged
            b.tagged := true
            b.pb := bar_index
            if brkFlag
                b.fl := array.new<line>()
                int kk = 0
                while kk <= 300 and time[kk] >= b.t
                    if time[kk] <= b.t1
                        b.fl.push(line.new(time[kk], high[kk], time[kk], low[kk], xloc = xloc.bar_time,
                             color = brkC(b.dir), width = 1))
                        b.fl.push(line.new(time[kk], open[kk], time[kk], close[kk], xloc = xloc.bar_time,
                             color = brkC(b.dir), width = 5))
                    kk += 1
            if not na(b.bx)  // drawn at the break: ends at the pullback, full fill
                b.bx.set_right(time)
                b.bx.set_bgcolor(color.new(brkShd ? color.gray : brkC(b.dir), brkShd ? 80 : (brkNoFill ? 100 : 85)))
                b.ml.set_x2(time)
            else if brkBox or brkShd
                b.bx := box.new(b.t, b.hi, time, b.lo, xloc = xloc.bar_time,
                    border_color = brkShd ? color.new(color.gray, 100) : brkC(b.dir), border_style = brkSty,
                    border_width = brkShd ? 0 : brkW, bgcolor = color.new(brkShd ? color.gray : brkC(b.dir), brkShd ? 80 : (brkNoFill ? 100 : 85)),
                    text = b.dir == 1 ? "B↑" : "B↓", text_color = brkC(b.dir), text_size = size.small,
                    text_halign = brkLblH, text_valign = brkLblV)
                b.ml := line.new(b.t, mid, time, mid, xloc = xloc.bar_time, color = brkC(b.dir), style = brkSty,
                    width = brkW)
    true

if brkOn and barstate.isconfirmed
    // bearish: high, low, higher high (the second high raids the first); armed on the low between them
    if not na(bPH) and blkPivot(bSqP, bSqB, bSqT, bPH, bar_index - brkLen, 1)
        if bSqT.size() == 3 and bSqT.get(0) == 1 and bSqB.get(1) != nz(bDnDone, -1)
            bDnLvl := bSqP.get(2) > bSqP.get(0) ? bSqP.get(1) : na
            bDnBar := bSqB.get(1)
    // bullish: low, high, lower low (the second low raids the first); armed on the high between them
    if not na(bPL) and blkPivot(bSqP, bSqB, bSqT, bPL, bar_index - brkLen, -1)
        if bSqT.size() == 3 and bSqT.get(0) == -1 and bSqB.get(1) != nz(bUpDone, -1)
            bUpLvl := bSqP.get(2) < bSqP.get(0) ? bSqP.get(1) : na
            bUpBar := bSqB.get(1)
    if not na(bDnLvl) and bar_index - bDnBar > brkAge
        bDnLvl := na
    if not na(bUpLvl) and bar_index - bUpBar > brkAge
        bUpLvl := na
    // the block forms on the close through that swing; it is drawn from then on
    if not na(bDnLvl) and close < bDnLvl
        [zh, zl, zt, zt1] = blkZone(-1, bar_index - bDnBar, false, brkMode == "Whole sequence")
        if not na(zt)
            brkAdd(-1, zh, zl, zt, zt1)
            Breaker nb = brks.last()
            nb.broken := true
            nb.bkBar := bar_index
            brkWait(nb)
        bDnDone := bDnBar
        bDnLvl := na
    if not na(bUpLvl) and close > bUpLvl
        [zh, zl, zt, zt1] = blkZone(1, bar_index - bUpBar, false, brkMode == "Whole sequence")
        if not na(zt)
            brkAdd(1, zh, zl, zt, zt1)
            Breaker nb = brks.last()
            nb.broken := true
            nb.bkBar := bar_index
            brkWait(nb)
        bUpDone := bUpBar
        bUpLvl := na
    if brks.size() > 0
        for i = brks.size() - 1 to 0
            Breaker b = brks.get(i)
            if not b.tagged and not na(b.bx)
                b.bx.set_right(time)
                b.ml.set_x2(time)
            if b.tagged
                // drawn: each pullback into the zone extends it (also a later one, after price left it in its
                // direction); it fails on a close through its far side (erased if no pullback worked yet) and
                // ends when no pullback came for the age limit
                if (b.dir == 1 and close < b.lo) or (b.dir == -1 and close > b.hi)
                    if not b.won
                        if not na(b.bx)
                            b.bx.delete()
                            b.ml.delete()
                        if not na(b.fl)
                            for ln in b.fl
                                ln.delete()
                    brks.remove(i)
                else if bar_index - b.pb > brkAge
                    brks.remove(i)
                else
                    if (b.dir == 1 and low <= b.hi) or (b.dir == -1 and high >= b.lo)
                        b.pb := bar_index
                        if not na(b.bx)
                            b.bx.set_right(time)
                            b.ml.set_x2(time)
                    if (b.dir == 1 and close > b.hi) or (b.dir == -1 and close < b.lo)
                        b.won := true
            else if bar_index - b.zb > brkAge
                brkDrop(brks.remove(i))  // no pullback in time: of no interest at this timeframe
            else if not b.broken
                if (b.dir == 1 and close > b.hi) or (b.dir == -1 and close < b.lo)
                    b.broken := true
                    b.bkBar := bar_index
                    brkWait(b)
            else if not b.swung
                // after the break: wait for a swing high above the zone (bullish) / low below it (bearish)
                if b.dir == 1 and not na(bPH) and bar_index - brkLen >= b.bkBar and bPH > b.hi
                    b.swung := true
                else if b.dir == -1 and not na(bPL) and bar_index - brkLen >= b.bkBar and bPL < b.lo
                    b.swung := true
                else if (b.dir == 1 and close < b.lo) or (b.dir == -1 and close > b.hi)
                    brkDrop(brks.remove(i))  // closed through the other side before the swing: invalidated
            else if (b.dir == 1 and close < b.lo) or (b.dir == -1 and close > b.hi)
                brkDrop(brks.remove(i))  // closed through the other side: invalidated
            else if (b.dir == 1 and low <= b.hi) or (b.dir == -1 and high >= b.lo)
                // pullback into the zone: tag the FVGs / IFVGs of the trade direction that overlap it
                array<FVG> fs0 = b.dir == 1 ? lfvgs : sfvgs
                for f in fs0
                    if na(f.end)
                        brkTag(f, b, na)
                if b.dir == 1
                    if not ifvgswings and not na(bullconfirm)
                        brkTag(bullifvg, b, ifvgBox)
                else
                    if not ifvgswings and not na(bearconfirm)
                        brkTag(bearifvg, b, ifvgBoxb)
                if b.tagged and ((b.dir == 1 and close < b.lo) or (b.dir == -1 and close > b.hi))
                    if not na(b.bx)
                        b.bx.delete()
                        b.ml.delete()
                    if not na(b.fl)
                        for ln in b.fl
                            ln.delete()
                    brks.remove(i)

// [MB] Mitigation blocks =============================================
type MBlock
    int dir         // 1 bullish (long after the pullback), -1 bearish
    float hi        // zone
    float lo
    int t           // time of the first candle of the zone
    bool broken = false
    int bkBar = na  // bar of the close beyond the zone
    bool swung = false  // a swing beyond the zone formed after the break (needed for the pullback)
    bool tagged = false // first pullback with a matching FVG / IFVG seen
    box bx = na     // drawn at that pullback (when the rectangle is on)
    line ml = na    // mid line
    int t1 = na     // time of the last candle of the zone
    int zb = na     // bar of the last candle of the zone (age)
    int pb = na     // bar of the last pullback into the zone (age once tagged)
    bool won = false // price left the zone in its direction after a pullback
    array<line> fl = na // flagged candles (wick and body lines)

var array<MBlock> mbs = array.new<MBlock>()
float mPH = ta.pivothigh(high, mbLen, mbLen)
float mPL = ta.pivotlow(low, mbLen, mbLen)
var array<float> mSqP = array.new<float>()  // swing sequence (ICTblocks)
var array<int> mSqB = array.new<int>()
var array<int> mSqT = array.new<int>()
var float mUpLvl = na  // swing high waiting for a close above it (bullish), its bar, the last one used
var int mUpBar = na
var int mUpDone = na
var float mDnLvl = na  // swing low waiting for a close below it (bearish)
var int mDnBar = na
var int mDnDone = na

// ICTblocks: the mitigation block is drawn from its break on, lighter, growing while it waits for the pullback;
// erased when it is dropped before the pullback (failed, too old or one too many)
mbWait(MBlock b) =>
    if mbBox or mbShd
        b.bx := box.new(b.t, b.hi, time, b.lo, xloc = xloc.bar_time,
            border_color = mbShd ? color.new(color.gray, 100) : mbC(b.dir), border_style = mbSty,
            border_width = mbShd ? 0 : mbW, bgcolor = color.new(mbShd ? color.gray : mbC(b.dir), mbShd ? 88 : (mbNoFill ? 100 : 93)),
            text = b.dir == 1 ? "M↑" : "M↓", text_color = mbC(b.dir), text_size = size.small,
            text_halign = mbLblH, text_valign = mbLblV)
        b.ml := line.new(b.t, (b.hi + b.lo) / 2, time, (b.hi + b.lo) / 2, xloc = xloc.bar_time, color = mbC(b.dir),
            style = mbSty, width = mbW)
    true
mbDrop(MBlock b) =>
    if not b.tagged and not na(b.bx)
        b.bx.delete()
        b.ml.delete()
    true

mbAdd(int dir, float zh, float zl, int zt, int zt1) =>
    int zk = 0
    while zk < 300 and time[zk] > zt1
        zk += 1
    mbs.push(MBlock.new(dir, zh, zl, zt, t1 = zt1, zb = bar_index - zk))
    int cnt = 0
    for b in mbs
        if b.dir == dir
            cnt += 1
    if cnt > mbKeep
        for i = 0 to mbs.size() - 1
            if mbs.get(i).dir == dir
                mbDrop(mbs.remove(i))
                break
    true

// mitigation block b drawn up to this candle when FVG / IFVG f overlaps it on the pullback (once); ib: the IFVG
// box when f is the confirmed IFVG (its label turns bold, with the arrow; which: 1 bull, -1 bear, 2 swing IFVG),
// else na (a plain unlabeled FVG gets M↑ / M↓)
// text of the IFVG label (which: 1 bull, -1 bear, 2 swing IFVG) with the mitigation block arrow mbd
mbTxt(int which, int mbd) =>
    which == 1 ? ifvgTxt(1, deInv ? bullInv : 1, useOTE and gBull.flagged, gBull.tags, bullAp, mbd)
     : ifvgTxt(-1, deInv ? bearInv : 1, useOTE and gBear.flagged, gBear.tags, bearAp, mbd)

mbTag(FVG f, MBlock b, box ib, int which) =>
    if not na(f) and f.hi >= b.lo and f.lo <= b.hi
        if not na(ib)
            if f.mbD != b.dir
                f.mbD := b.dir
                bumpTags()
                ib.set_text(mbTxt(which, f.mbD))
            ib.set_text_formatting(text.format_bold)
        else
            f.mbD := b.dir
            bumpTags()
            f.lblD := b.dir
            if na(f.end) and (not f.kept or (f.cand and not confIfvg(f))) and not (f.aplus and lblAp) and not na(f.rect)
                f.rect.set_text(fvgLbl(f))
                f.rect.set_text_size(ifvgtsz)
                f.rect.set_text_halign(ifvgha)
                f.rect.set_text_valign(ifvgva)
        float mid = (b.hi + b.lo) / 2
        if not b.tagged
            b.tagged := true
            b.pb := bar_index
            if mbFlag
                b.fl := array.new<line>()
                int kk = 0
                while kk <= 300 and time[kk] >= b.t
                    if time[kk] <= b.t1
                        b.fl.push(line.new(time[kk], high[kk], time[kk], low[kk], xloc = xloc.bar_time,
                             color = mbC(b.dir), width = 1))
                        b.fl.push(line.new(time[kk], open[kk], time[kk], close[kk], xloc = xloc.bar_time,
                             color = mbC(b.dir), width = 5))
                    kk += 1
            if not na(b.bx)  // drawn at the break: ends at the pullback, full fill
                b.bx.set_right(time)
                b.bx.set_bgcolor(color.new(mbShd ? color.gray : mbC(b.dir), mbShd ? 80 : (mbNoFill ? 100 : 85)))
                b.ml.set_x2(time)
            else if mbBox or mbShd
                b.bx := box.new(b.t, b.hi, time, b.lo, xloc = xloc.bar_time,
                    border_color = mbShd ? color.new(color.gray, 100) : mbC(b.dir), border_style = mbSty,
                    border_width = mbShd ? 0 : mbW, bgcolor = color.new(mbShd ? color.gray : mbC(b.dir), mbShd ? 80 : (mbNoFill ? 100 : 85)),
                    text = b.dir == 1 ? "M↑" : "M↓", text_color = mbC(b.dir), text_size = size.small,
                    text_halign = mbLblH, text_valign = mbLblV)
                b.ml := line.new(b.t, mid, time, mid, xloc = xloc.bar_time, color = mbC(b.dir), style = mbSty,
                    width = mbW)
    true

if mbOn and barstate.isconfirmed
    // bearish: high, low, lower high (the second high fails to reach the first); armed on the low between them
    if not na(mPH) and blkPivot(mSqP, mSqB, mSqT, mPH, bar_index - mbLen, 1)
        if mSqT.size() == 3 and mSqT.get(0) == 1 and mSqB.get(1) != nz(mDnDone, -1)
            mDnLvl := mSqP.get(2) < mSqP.get(0) ? mSqP.get(1) : na
            mDnBar := mSqB.get(1)
    // bullish: low, high, higher low (the second low fails to reach the first); armed on the high between them
    if not na(mPL) and blkPivot(mSqP, mSqB, mSqT, mPL, bar_index - mbLen, -1)
        if mSqT.size() == 3 and mSqT.get(0) == -1 and mSqB.get(1) != nz(mUpDone, -1)
            mUpLvl := mSqP.get(2) > mSqP.get(0) ? mSqP.get(1) : na
            mUpBar := mSqB.get(1)
    if not na(mDnLvl) and bar_index - mDnBar > mbAge
        mDnLvl := na
    if not na(mUpLvl) and bar_index - mUpBar > mbAge
        mUpLvl := na
    // the block forms on the close through that swing; it is drawn from then on
    if not na(mDnLvl) and close < mDnLvl
        [zh, zl, zt, zt1] = blkZone(-1, bar_index - mDnBar, true, mbMode == "Whole sequence")
        if not na(zt)
            mbAdd(-1, zh, zl, zt, zt1)
            MBlock nb = mbs.last()
            nb.broken := true
            nb.bkBar := bar_index
            mbWait(nb)
        mDnDone := mDnBar
        mDnLvl := na
    if not na(mUpLvl) and close > mUpLvl
        [zh, zl, zt, zt1] = blkZone(1, bar_index - mUpBar, true, mbMode == "Whole sequence")
        if not na(zt)
            mbAdd(1, zh, zl, zt, zt1)
            MBlock nb = mbs.last()
            nb.broken := true
            nb.bkBar := bar_index
            mbWait(nb)
        mUpDone := mUpBar
        mUpLvl := na
    if mbs.size() > 0
        for i = mbs.size() - 1 to 0
            MBlock b = mbs.get(i)
            if not b.tagged and not na(b.bx)
                b.bx.set_right(time)
                b.ml.set_x2(time)
            if b.tagged
                // drawn: each pullback into the zone extends it (also a later one, after price left it in its
                // direction); it fails on a close through its far side (erased if no pullback worked yet) and
                // ends when no pullback came for the age limit
                if (b.dir == 1 and close < b.lo) or (b.dir == -1 and close > b.hi)
                    if not b.won
                        if not na(b.bx)
                            b.bx.delete()
                            b.ml.delete()
                        if not na(b.fl)
                            for ln in b.fl
                                ln.delete()
                    mbs.remove(i)
                else if bar_index - b.pb > mbAge
                    mbs.remove(i)
                else
                    if (b.dir == 1 and low <= b.hi) or (b.dir == -1 and high >= b.lo)
                        b.pb := bar_index
                        if not na(b.bx)
                            b.bx.set_right(time)
                            b.ml.set_x2(time)
                    if (b.dir == 1 and close > b.hi) or (b.dir == -1 and close < b.lo)
                        b.won := true
            else if bar_index - b.zb > mbAge
                mbDrop(mbs.remove(i))  // no pullback in time: of no interest at this timeframe
            else if not b.broken
                if (b.dir == 1 and close > b.hi) or (b.dir == -1 and close < b.lo)
                    b.broken := true
                    b.bkBar := bar_index
                    mbWait(b)
            else if not b.swung
                // after the break: wait for a swing high above the zone (bullish) / low below it (bearish)
                if b.dir == 1 and not na(mPH) and bar_index - mbLen >= b.bkBar and mPH > b.hi
                    b.swung := true
                else if b.dir == -1 and not na(mPL) and bar_index - mbLen >= b.bkBar and mPL < b.lo
                    b.swung := true
                else if (b.dir == 1 and close < b.lo) or (b.dir == -1 and close > b.hi)
                    mbDrop(mbs.remove(i))  // closed through the other side before the swing: invalidated
            else if (b.dir == 1 and close < b.lo) or (b.dir == -1 and close > b.hi)
                mbDrop(mbs.remove(i))  // closed through the other side: invalidated
            else if (b.dir == 1 and low <= b.hi) or (b.dir == -1 and high >= b.lo)
                // pullback into the zone: tag the FVGs / IFVGs of the trade direction that overlap it
                array<FVG> fs0 = b.dir == 1 ? lfvgs : sfvgs
                for f in fs0
                    if na(f.end)
                        mbTag(f, b, na, 0)
                if b.dir == 1
                    if not ifvgswings and not na(bullconfirm)
                        mbTag(bullifvg, b, ifvgBox, 1)
                else
                    if not ifvgswings and not na(bearconfirm)
                        mbTag(bearifvg, b, ifvgBoxb, -1)
                if b.tagged and ((b.dir == 1 and close < b.lo) or (b.dir == -1 and close > b.hi))
                    if not na(b.bx)
                        b.bx.delete()
                        b.ml.delete()
                    if not na(b.fl)
                        for ln in b.fl
                            ln.delete()
                    mbs.remove(i)

// [MB] a confirmed IFVG overlapping an FVG of its direction that a breaker / mitigation block tagged (live, or
// mitigated after the IFVG's FVG started) gets the same tag: bold label, plus the arrow for a mitigation block
ifvgInherit(FVG iv, box ib, int which, int dir) =>
    // [PERF] the tags of the FVGs did not change since the last scan for this IFVG: nothing new to inherit
    if not na(iv) and not na(ib) and (na(iv.inhSeq) or iv.inhSeq != tagSeq.get(0))
        iv.inhSeq := tagSeq.get(0)
        array<FVG> fs = dir == 1 ? lfvgs : sfvgs
        bool gb = false
        bool gm = false
        for f in fs
            if (na(f.end) or f.end >= iv.start) and f.hi >= iv.lo and f.lo <= iv.hi
                if f.brkD == dir and brkOn
                    gb := true
                if f.mbD == dir and mbOn
                    gm := true
        if gb and not iv.brk
            iv.brk := true
            ib.set_text_formatting(text.format_bold)
        if gm and iv.mbD != dir
            iv.mbD := dir
            ib.set_text(mbTxt(which, dir))
            ib.set_text_formatting(text.format_bold)
    true

if (brkOn or mbOn) and barstate.isconfirmed
    if not ifvgswings
        if not na(bullconfirm)
            ifvgInherit(bullifvg, ifvgBox, 1, 1)
        if not na(bearconfirm)
            ifvgInherit(bearifvg, ifvgBoxb, -1, -1)

// [OTE] signals: IFVG retraced into and matches the OTE band =================
int bearOteSig = 0
int bullOteSig = 0
int swOteSig = 0

int oteSig = 0
if bearOteSig != 0
    oteSig := -1
else if bullOteSig != 0
    oteSig := 1
else if swOteSig != 0
    oteSig := swOteSig

if doifvg and useOTE
    if bearOteSig != 0 and not na(ifvgBoxb)
        ifvgBoxb.set_text(ifvgTxt(-1, 1, true, gBear.tags, bearAp, mbOf(bearifvg)))
        if not isFp(bearifvg)
            ifvgBoxb.set_border_color(oteHighlight)
    if bullOteSig != 0 and not na(ifvgBox)
        ifvgBox.set_text(ifvgTxt(1, 1, true, gBull.tags, bullAp, mbOf(bullifvg)))
        if not isFp(bullifvg)
            ifvgBox.set_border_color(oteHighlight)

plotshape(showSignals and not hideReg and sig == -1 and sig[1] == 0, 
    title = "SHORT", style = shape.triangledown, 
        location = location.abovebar, color = bearIFVGColor, size = size.small, text = "SHORT")

plotshape(showSignals and not hideReg and sig == 1 and sig[1] == 0, 
    title = "LONG", style = shape.triangleup, 
        location = location.belowbar, color = bullIFVGColor, size = size.small, text = "LONG")

plotshape(showOTEsig and not hideReg and oteSig == -1, 
    title = "SHORT OTE", style = shape.diamond, 
        location = location.abovebar, color = oteHighlight, size = size.small, text = "OTE")

plotshape(showOTEsig and not hideReg and oteSig == 1, 
    title = "LONG OTE", style = shape.diamond, 
        location = location.belowbar, color = oteHighlight, size = size.small, text = "OTE")

//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// ALERTS
//──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
tfstr() =>
    string tf = timeframe.period
    if timeframe.isseconds
        str.replace(tf, "S", "s")
    else if timeframe.isminutes
        if tf == "60"
            "1h"
        else if tf == "120"
            "2h"
        else if tf == "180"
            "3h"
        else if tf == "240"
            "4h"
        else
            tf + "m"
    else if timeframe.isdaily
        // If it's exactly 1 day ("1D"), UI just shows "D"
        tf == "1D" ? "D" : str.replace(tf, "D", "D") 
    else if timeframe.isweekly
        tf == "1W" ? "W" : str.replace(tf, "W", "W")
    else if timeframe.ismonthly
        tf == "1M" ? "M" : str.replace(tf, "M", "M")
    else
        tf


if doifvgalert and sig != 0 and not (useOTE and oteOnly) // [OTE] plain IFVG alerts can be suppressed
    if sig > 0
        alert("LONG IFVG "+tfstr(), alert.freq_once_per_bar)
    else
        alert("SHORT IFVG "+tfstr(), alert.freq_once_per_bar)

// [OTE] alerts
if doifvgalert and useOTE and oteSig != 0
    if oteSig > 0
        alert("LONG IFVG+OTE "+tfstr(), alert.freq_once_per_bar)
    else
        alert("SHORT IFVG+OTE "+tfstr(), alert.freq_once_per_bar)
